compass:goal-breakdown.title: 目标拆解
compass:goal-breakdown.description: 拆解目标、步骤、时间与交付物
compass:goal-breakdown.prompt: 请把【目标】拆解为可执行步骤，明确里程碑、优先级、截止时间和下一步行动。
compass:goal-breakdown.materialHint: 目标描述、截止时间、当前进度和限制条件（可选）
compass:goal-breakdown.followUpPrompt: 请基于刚才的目标拆解，检查是否遗漏依赖项，并把下一步行动细化到负责人、开始时间和完成标准。
compass:goal-breakdown.output: 目标分解、阶段里程碑、优先级和下一步行动

compass:execution-plan.title: 执行计划
compass:execution-plan.description: 安排阶段、时间、负责人和检查点
compass:execution-plan.prompt: 请为【目标】制定执行计划，拆分阶段任务，安排时间与负责人，并标出检查点、风险和调整条件。
compass:execution-plan.materialHint: 目标、截止时间、可用资源、参与人员和限制条件（可选）
compass:execution-plan.followUpPrompt: 请复核刚才的执行计划，补充关键路径、资源冲突、风险触发条件和每个检查点的验收标准。
compass:execution-plan.output: 分阶段执行计划、时间安排、责任分工、检查点和风险预案

compass:option-comparison.title: 方案比较
compass:option-comparison.description: 从成本、风险与效果给出建议
compass:option-comparison.prompt: 请比较【方案 A】和【方案 B】。从成本、效果、风险和适用条件分析，并给出明确建议。
compass:option-comparison.materialHint: 候选方案、预算、时间限制和最看重的判断标准（可选）
compass:option-comparison.followUpPrompt: 请基于刚才的方案比较，补充权重与敏感性分析，并说明在什么条件变化下应改选另一方案。
compass:option-comparison.output: 方案对比、关键取舍、适用条件和有依据的建议

compass:comprehensive-analysis.title: 综合分析
compass:comprehensive-analysis.description: 综合目标、现状、证据、风险与建议
compass:comprehensive-analysis.prompt: 请综合分析【问题】。先确认目标和背景，再从现状、证据、影响因素、风险与机会展开，并给出行动建议。
compass:comprehensive-analysis.materialHint: 待分析的问题、背景资料、目标、数据和限制条件（可选）
compass:comprehensive-analysis.followUpPrompt: 请继续完善刚才的综合分析，区分事实、假设和待验证项，并按影响与紧急程度排列建议。
compass:comprehensive-analysis.output: 现状判断、关键证据、影响因素、风险机会和行动建议

content:topic-planning.title: 选题策划
content:topic-planning.description: 确定受众、角度和内容系列
content:topic-planning.prompt: 围绕【主题】帮我策划选题。请先确认平台、受众和目标，再给出 10 个具体选题及推荐理由。
content:topic-planning.materialHint: 主题、平台、目标受众、账号定位和参考内容（可选）
content:topic-planning.followUpPrompt: 请从刚才的选题中筛选最值得先做的 3 个，分别补充标题方向、内容大纲、素材需求和发布顺序。
content:topic-planning.output: 按主题分组的选题清单、切入角度和推荐理由

content:long-form-writing.title: 长文写作
content:long-form-writing.description: 撰写结构完整、可继续修改的长文
content:long-form-writing.prompt: 请围绕【主题】撰写一篇【平台】长文。先确认受众、语气和篇幅，再交付包含标题、开头、正文结构与结尾引导的初稿。
content:long-form-writing.materialHint: 主题、受众、发布平台、语气、篇幅和事实素材（可选）
content:long-form-writing.followUpPrompt: 请审校刚才的长文初稿，检查事实依据和逻辑跳跃，并优化标题、开头、段落衔接和结尾行动引导。
content:long-form-writing.output: 包含标题、开头、正文结构和结尾引导的长文初稿

content:short-video-script.title: 短视频脚本
content:short-video-script.description: 设计开场、口播、画面与节奏
content:short-video-script.prompt: 请为【主题】写一份【平台及时长】短视频脚本，包括开场钩子、口播、画面提示、节奏和行动引导。
content:short-video-script.materialHint: 主题、平台、目标受众、视频时长、产品信息和参考内容（可选）
content:short-video-script.followUpPrompt: 请把刚才的短视频脚本细化为逐秒节奏，标出口播、画面、字幕、转场和需要准备的素材。
content:short-video-script.output: 包含开场钩子、口播、画面提示、节奏和行动引导的短视频脚本

content:rewrite-polish.title: 改写润色
content:rewrite-polish.description: 保留原意并优化结构、语气和表达
content:rewrite-polish.prompt: 请优化并润色我提供的文案，保留事实和原意，重点改善标题、开头、结构、语气与表达节奏。
content:rewrite-polish.materialHint: 原文、发布平台、目标受众、目标语气和需要保留的事实（可选）
content:rewrite-polish.followUpPrompt: 请对照原文复核刚才的润色稿，列出关键修改及理由，并再提供一个更简洁和一个更有感染力的版本。
content:rewrite-polish.output: 保留原意的润色稿、修改说明和可选标题

video:shooting-script.title: 拍摄脚本
video:shooting-script.description: 设计口播、画面和内容节奏
video:shooting-script.prompt: 请为【主题】写一份【平台及时长】拍摄脚本，包括开头、口播、画面提示和行动引导。
video:shooting-script.materialHint: 主题、平台、时长、人物、产品信息和拍摄条件（可选）
video:shooting-script.followUpPrompt: 请把刚才的拍摄脚本整理成可执行拍摄清单，补充场景、人物动作、道具、机位、收音和预计时长。
video:shooting-script.output: 按段落整理的口播、画面、动作、道具和时长建议

video:storyboard.title: 分镜清单
video:storyboard.description: 明确景别、机位、动作和时长
video:storyboard.prompt: 请把我提供的脚本拆成分镜表，列出镜号、景别、画面、台词、机位、时长和转场。
video:storyboard.materialHint: 脚本、参考视频、目标时长、画面比例和可用场景（可选）
video:storyboard.followUpPrompt: 请复核刚才的分镜表，补充镜头衔接、备用镜头、现场风险和每个镜头的拍摄优先级。
video:storyboard.output: 包含镜号、景别、机位、画面、台词、时长和转场的分镜表

video:editing-rhythm.title: 剪辑节奏
video:editing-rhythm.description: 规划剪辑结构、时长分配和情绪变化
video:editing-rhythm.prompt: 请为【视频主题】设计剪辑节奏，按时间段规划内容结构、素材取舍、情绪变化、转场和节奏重点。
video:editing-rhythm.materialHint: 脚本或素材、发布平台、目标时长、受众和参考节奏（可选）
video:editing-rhythm.followUpPrompt: 请把刚才的剪辑节奏细化到时间轴，标出保留与删减素材、音乐节拍、字幕密度和转场节点。
video:editing-rhythm.output: 分段时长、剪辑节奏、素材取舍、情绪曲线和转场建议

video:title-cover.title: 标题封面
video:title-cover.description: 生成标题方向、封面文案和视觉建议
video:title-cover.prompt: 请为【视频主题】设计标题和封面方案，给出多组标题、封面文案、构图、视觉重点及测试建议。
video:title-cover.materialHint: 视频主题、平台、目标受众、核心卖点和封面素材（可选）
video:title-cover.followUpPrompt: 请从刚才的标题和封面方案中选出 3 组最强组合，并说明受众、信息层级、视觉焦点和 A/B 测试方式。
video:title-cover.output: 标题备选、封面文案、画面构图、视觉重点和测试建议

ecommerce:product-copy.title: 商品文案
ecommerce:product-copy.description: 撰写标题、卖点、场景和转化文案
ecommerce:product-copy.prompt: 请为【商品】撰写商品文案。先确认目标人群、价格带和真实卖点，再输出标题、分层卖点、场景说明、证明信息和行动引导。
ecommerce:product-copy.materialHint: 商品信息、目标人群、规格参数、真实卖点和证明材料（可选）
ecommerce:product-copy.followUpPrompt: 请复核刚才的商品文案，区分可验证事实与营销表达，并针对详情页首屏、卖点区和行动引导分别优化。
ecommerce:product-copy.output: 商品标题、分层卖点、场景说明、证明信息和行动引导

ecommerce:campaign-plan.title: 活动策划
ecommerce:campaign-plan.description: 规划目标、节奏、渠道和执行清单
ecommerce:campaign-plan.prompt: 请为【商品或店铺】制定【活动】策划方案，明确目标、人群、时间节奏、渠道动作、预算、库存风险和复盘指标。
ecommerce:campaign-plan.materialHint: 活动目标、商品、预算、周期、渠道、库存和历史数据（可选）
ecommerce:campaign-plan.followUpPrompt: 请把刚才的活动方案细化为执行表，补充每日节点、负责人、预算分配、库存预警和复盘口径。
ecommerce:campaign-plan.output: 活动主题、目标人群、时间节奏、渠道动作、预算和复盘指标

ecommerce:competitor-analysis.title: 竞品分析
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.description: 对比定位、价格、内容和用户评价
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.prompt: 请分析【竞品】。按定位、价格、卖点、页面内容和用户评价对比，并指出可利用的差异化机会。
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.materialHint: 自家商品、竞品资料、价格、页面内容和用户评价（可选）
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.followUpPrompt: 请基于刚才的竞品分析，补充证据来源和差异化优先级，并给出 3 个可立即验证的小实验。
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.output: 定位、价格、卖点、页面和评价差异的竞品分析报告

ecommerce:review-customer-service.title: 评价与客服
ecommerce:review-customer-service.description: 分析用户评价并整理客服应答
ecommerce:review-customer-service.prompt: 请分析【商品或店铺】的用户评价，归纳高频问题和改进方向，并整理覆盖售前、异议、物流与售后的客服话术。
ecommerce:review-customer-service.materialHint: 商品或店铺信息、用户评价、常见问题、物流和售后规则（可选）
ecommerce:review-customer-service.followUpPrompt: 请把刚才的评价分析转成处理清单，并按售前、异议、物流、售后场景优化话术和升级条件。
ecommerce:review-customer-service.output: 评价问题归类、改进建议和覆盖售前售后的客服话术

office:document-writing.title: 文档撰写
office:document-writing.description: 从现有资料生成正式文档
office:document-writing.prompt: 请把我提供的资料整理成一份【文档类型】，先确认读者和用途，再输出清晰结构与正文初稿。
office:document-writing.materialHint: 参考资料、文档类型、读者、用途、篇幅和格式要求（可选）
office:document-writing.followUpPrompt: 请审校刚才的文档初稿，检查结构、事实、术语和语气，并列出仍需我确认的信息后再给出修订版。
office:document-writing.output: 清晰的文档结构、正文初稿和待确认问题

office:spreadsheet-analysis.title: 表格分析
office:spreadsheet-analysis.description: 清洗、分析和汇总业务数据
office:spreadsheet-analysis.prompt: 请处理我提供的表格。先说明可读取的数据范围，再完成清洗、关键指标分析和汇总结论。
office:spreadsheet-analysis.materialHint: 表格文件、字段说明、业务问题、时间范围和指标口径（可选）
office:spreadsheet-analysis.followUpPrompt: 请继续核对刚才的表格分析，说明数据口径、异常值处理和结论限制，并补充最值得展示的图表方案。
office:spreadsheet-analysis.output: 清洗说明、关键指标、异常项、分析结论和图表建议

office:meeting-minutes.title: 会议纪要
office:meeting-minutes.description: 提取决策、责任人和截止时间
office:meeting-minutes.prompt: 请把会议记录整理成纪要，分为结论、待办、责任人、截止时间和仍需确认的问题。
office:meeting-minutes.materialHint: 会议录音转写、手写记录、参会人和会议议程（可选）
office:meeting-minutes.followUpPrompt: 请复核刚才的会议纪要，区分已决事项、待办和未决问题，并补充每项负责人、截止时间和依赖关系。
office:meeting-minutes.output: 会议结论、待办事项、负责人、截止时间和未决问题

office:presentation-outline.title: PPT 大纲
office:presentation-outline.description: 构建提纲、要点和演示结构
office:presentation-outline.prompt: 请为【汇报主题】制作汇报提纲，明确听众、目标和时长，并给出逐页要点与数据需求。
office:presentation-outline.materialHint: 汇报主题、听众、时长、已有数据和品牌模板（可选）
office:presentation-outline.followUpPrompt: 请把刚才的 PPT 大纲细化为逐页脚本，补充每页核心结论、所需证据、讲述时长和视觉表达。
office:presentation-outline.output: 逐页目的、核心要点、证据需求和视觉建议

research:source-organization.title: 资料梳理
research:source-organization.description: 整理来源、主题、证据和待查问题
research:source-organization.prompt: 请梳理我提供的【资料】。按主题整理来源、核心内容、证据出处和可靠性，并列出仍需核实的问题。
research:source-organization.materialHint: 资料文件或链接、整理目的、研究范围和来源标准（可选）
research:source-organization.followUpPrompt: 请继续整理刚才的资料梳理，去除重复来源，标出相互印证或冲突的证据，并生成优先核实的问题清单。
research:source-organization.output: 资料目录、主题摘要、证据出处、可靠性说明和待查问题

research:viewpoint-comparison.title: 观点比较
research:viewpoint-comparison.description: 比较证据、分歧和适用条件
research:viewpoint-comparison.prompt: 请比较关于【问题】的不同观点，分别列出依据、争议点、适用条件和你的综合判断。
research:viewpoint-comparison.materialHint: 待比较的问题、主要观点、已有来源和判断标准（可选）
research:viewpoint-comparison.followUpPrompt: 请复核刚才的观点比较，检查证据强弱与适用边界，并说明哪些新证据会改变当前判断。
research:viewpoint-comparison.output: 证据对照、共识与分歧、适用条件和综合判断

research:learning-plan.title: 学习计划
research:learning-plan.description: 设置阶段目标、材料和练习
research:learning-plan.prompt: 请为我制定【主题】学习计划。根据当前基础、可用时间和目标，安排阶段任务、资料与练习。
research:learning-plan.materialHint: 学习目标、当前基础、可用时间、截止日期和已有资料（可选）
research:learning-plan.followUpPrompt: 请把刚才的学习计划细化到第一周，安排每日任务、练习、检查标准，并给出进度落后时的调整方案。
research:learning-plan.output: 分阶段目标、每周任务、学习材料、练习和检查点

research:research-report.title: 研究报告
research:research-report.description: 形成问题、方法、发现和结论完整的报告
research:research-report.prompt: 请围绕【研究问题】撰写研究报告，明确背景、方法、资料来源、主要发现、限制、结论和建议。
research:research-report.materialHint: 研究问题、资料来源、分析范围、读者和格式要求（可选）
research:research-report.followUpPrompt: 请审校刚才的研究报告，区分结论、证据和推断，补充局限性，并按重要性列出需要进一步验证的内容。
research:research-report.output: 研究背景、方法、证据、发现、限制、结论和建议

family:travel-plan.title: 旅行规划
family:travel-plan.description: 安排路线、时间、费用和备选方案
family:travel-plan.prompt: 请规划一次【目的地】家庭旅行。先确认成员、日期和预算，再给出路线、时间、费用、预订事项和备选方案。
family:travel-plan.materialHint: 目的地、家庭成员、日期、预算、出行偏好和限制（可选）
family:travel-plan.followUpPrompt: 请把刚才的旅行规划细化为每日行程，补充交通衔接、预订节点、费用区间、儿童或长者需求和天气备选。
family:travel-plan.output: 旅行路线、时间安排、费用、预订事项和备选方案

family:family-checklist.title: 家庭清单
family:family-checklist.description: 整理物品、分工、时间和完成状态
family:family-checklist.prompt: 请把【家庭事项】整理成家庭清单，按类别列出物品或任务、负责人、时间节点和完成检查项。
family:family-checklist.materialHint: 家庭事项、成员、截止时间、现有物品和特殊需求（可选）
family:family-checklist.followUpPrompt: 请复核刚才的家庭清单，合并重复项，补充负责人、截止时间、前置条件和出发前的最终检查。
family:family-checklist.output: 按类别整理的家庭清单、负责人、时间节点和检查状态

family:purchase-comparison.title: 购买比较
family:purchase-comparison.description: 比较价格、质量、风险和适用场景
family:purchase-comparison.prompt: 请比较【商品 A】和【商品 B】的购买选择，从价格、质量、功能、评价、售后和适用场景分析并给出建议。
family:purchase-comparison.materialHint: 候选商品、预算、使用需求、参数、评价和售后条件（可选）
family:purchase-comparison.followUpPrompt: 请基于刚才的购买比较，按预算、核心需求和风险重新排序，并列出购买前必须核实的参数与售后条款。
family:purchase-comparison.output: 购买选项对比、关键取舍、风险提示和推荐结论

family:schedule-plan.title: 日程安排
family:schedule-plan.description: 整理分工、提醒和执行清单
family:schedule-plan.prompt: 请把【家庭事务】整理成日程安排，明确时间、家庭成员分工、准备物品和提醒节点。
family:schedule-plan.materialHint: 家庭成员、固定事项、可用时段、优先级和个人偏好（可选）
family:schedule-plan.followUpPrompt: 请检查刚才的日程安排是否有冲突，补充缓冲时间、成员分工、提醒节点和临时变更时的替代方案。
family:schedule-plan.output: 按日期和成员整理的安排、冲突提示、缓冲时间和提醒

compass:goal-breakdown.title: 目標拆解
compass:goal-breakdown.description: 將目標拆成步驟、時程與交付成果
compass:goal-breakdown.prompt: 請將[目標]拆解為可執行步驟，列出里程碑、優先順序、截止時間與下一個行動。
compass:goal-breakdown.materialHint: 目標描述、截止時間、目前進度和限制條件（可選）
compass:goal-breakdown.followUpPrompt: 請根據剛才的目標拆解，檢查是否遺漏相依事項，並將下一步行動細化為負責人、開始時間與完成標準。
compass:goal-breakdown.output: 目標拆解、階段里程碑、優先順序和下一步行動

compass:execution-plan.title: 執行計畫
compass:execution-plan.description: 安排階段、時程、負責人與檢查點
compass:execution-plan.prompt: 請為[目標]建立執行計畫，包含分階段任務、時程、負責人、檢查點、風險與調整條件。
compass:execution-plan.materialHint: 目標、截止時間、可用資源、參與人員和限制條件（可選）
compass:execution-plan.followUpPrompt: 請檢視剛才的執行計畫，補充關鍵路徑、資源衝突、風險觸發條件，以及每個檢查點的驗收標準。
compass:execution-plan.output: 分階段執行計畫、時間安排、責任分工、檢查點和風險預案

compass:option-comparison.title: 方案比較
compass:option-comparison.description: 比較成本、風險與預期成果
compass:option-comparison.prompt: 請從成本、成果、風險與適用性比較[方案 A]和[方案 B]，並提出理由清楚的建議。
compass:option-comparison.materialHint: 候選方案、預算、時間限制和最重視的判斷標準（可選）
compass:option-comparison.followUpPrompt: 請根據剛才的方案比較，補充權重與敏感度分析，並說明哪些條件改變時應改選另一個方案。
compass:option-comparison.output: 方案比較、關鍵取捨、適用條件和有依據的建議

compass:comprehensive-analysis.title: 綜合分析
compass:comprehensive-analysis.description: 整合目標、背景、證據、風險與建議
compass:comprehensive-analysis.prompt: 請全面分析[問題]。先確認目標與背景，再評估證據、關鍵因素、風險、機會與建議行動。
compass:comprehensive-analysis.materialHint: 待分析的問題、背景資料、目標、資料和限制條件（可選）
compass:comprehensive-analysis.followUpPrompt: 請繼續完善剛才的綜合分析，區分事實、假設與待驗證事項，並依影響程度和急迫性排列建議。
compass:comprehensive-analysis.output: 現況判斷、關鍵證據、影響因素、風險機會和行動建議

content:topic-planning.title: 選題規劃
content:topic-planning.description: 確認受眾、切入角度與系列方向
content:topic-planning.prompt: 請規劃[主題]的內容題目。先確認平台、受眾與目標，再提供 10 個具體題目及推薦理由。
content:topic-planning.materialHint: 主題、平台、目標受眾、帳號定位和參考內容（可選）
content:topic-planning.followUpPrompt: 請從剛才的選題中挑出最值得優先製作的 3 個，分別補充標題方向、內容大綱、素材需求與發布順序。
content:topic-planning.output: 依主題分組的題目清單、切入角度和推薦理由

content:long-form-writing.title: 長文寫作
content:long-form-writing.description: 撰寫完整且可編輯的長文初稿
content:long-form-writing.prompt: 請為[平台]撰寫一篇關於[主題]的長文。先確認受眾、語氣與篇幅，再提供標題、開頭、結構完整的正文和結尾行動引導。
content:long-form-writing.materialHint: 主題、受眾、發布平台、語氣、篇幅和事實素材（可選）
content:long-form-writing.followUpPrompt: 請校閱剛才的長文初稿，檢查事實依據與邏輯跳躍，並改善標題、開頭、段落銜接和結尾行動引導。
content:long-form-writing.output: 包含標題、開頭、正文結構和結尾引導的長文初稿

content:short-video-script.title: 短影音腳本
content:short-video-script.description: 設計開場鉤子、口播、畫面與節奏
content:short-video-script.prompt: 請為[平台與時長]撰寫一支關於[主題]的短影音腳本，包含開場鉤子、口播、畫面提示、節奏與行動引導。
content:short-video-script.materialHint: 主題、平台、目標受眾、影片時長、產品資訊和參考內容（可選）
content:short-video-script.followUpPrompt: 請將剛才的短影音腳本細化為逐秒節奏，標出口播、畫面、字幕、轉場與需要準備的素材。
content:short-video-script.output: 包含開場鉤子、口播、畫面提示、節奏和行動引導的短影音腳本

content:rewrite-polish.title: 改寫與潤飾
content:rewrite-polish.description: 保留原意，同時改善結構、語氣與表達
content:rewrite-polish.prompt: 請改寫並潤飾[原文]，保留原有事實與意圖，並改善標題、開頭、結構、語氣與節奏。
content:rewrite-polish.materialHint: 原文、發布平台、目標受眾、目標語氣和需要保留的事實（可選）
content:rewrite-polish.followUpPrompt: 請對照原文檢視剛才的潤飾稿，列出主要修改與理由，並再提供一個更精簡和一個更有感染力的版本。
content:rewrite-polish.output: 保留原意的潤色稿、修改說明和可選標題

video:shooting-script.title: 拍攝腳本
video:shooting-script.prompt: 請為[平台與時長]撰寫一支關於[主題]的拍攝腳本，包含開場鉤子、口播、畫面提示與行動引導。
video:shooting-script.materialHint: 主題、平台、時長、人物、產品資訊和拍攝條件（可選）
video:shooting-script.followUpPrompt: 請將剛才的拍攝腳本整理成可執行的拍攝清單，補充場景、人物動作、道具、機位、收音與預估時間。
video:shooting-script.output: 依段落整理的口播、畫面、動作、道具和時長建議

video:storyboard.title: 分鏡表
video:storyboard.description: 定義景別、機位、動作與時間
video:storyboard.prompt: 請將[腳本]整理成分鏡表，列出鏡號、景別、畫面、台詞、機位、時長與轉場。
video:storyboard.materialHint: 腳本、參考影片、目標時長、畫面比例和可用場景（可選）
video:storyboard.followUpPrompt: 請檢視剛才的分鏡表，補充鏡頭銜接、備用鏡頭、現場風險，以及每個鏡頭的拍攝優先順序。
video:storyboard.output: 包含鏡號、景別、機位、畫面、台詞、時長和轉場的分鏡表

video:editing-rhythm.title: 剪輯節奏
video:editing-rhythm.description: 規劃剪輯結構、時間與情緒推進
video:editing-rhythm.prompt: 請為[影片主題]設計剪輯節奏，依時間區段安排內容結構、素材取捨、情緒變化、轉場與速度。
video:editing-rhythm.materialHint: 腳本或素材、發布平台、目標時長、受眾和參考節奏（可選）
video:editing-rhythm.followUpPrompt: 請將剛才的剪輯節奏細化到時間軸，標出保留與刪減素材、音樂節拍、字幕密度和轉場節點。
video:editing-rhythm.output: 分段時長、剪輯節奏、素材取捨、情緒曲線和轉場建議

video:title-cover.title: 標題與封面
video:title-cover.description: 產出標題方向、封面文案與視覺指引
video:title-cover.prompt: 請為[影片主題]設計標題與封面方案，包含多組標題、封面文案、構圖、視覺重點與測試方式。
video:title-cover.materialHint: 影片主題、平台、目標受眾、核心賣點和封面素材（可選）
video:title-cover.followUpPrompt: 請從剛才的標題與封面方案中選出 3 組最強組合，並說明受眾、資訊層級、視覺焦點和 A/B 測試方式。
video:title-cover.output: 標題備選、封面文案、畫面構圖、視覺重點和測試建議

ecommerce:product-copy.title: 商品文案
ecommerce:product-copy.description: 撰寫標題、賣點、情境與轉換文案
ecommerce:product-copy.prompt: 請為[商品]撰寫商品文案。先確認目標族群、價格區間與已證實的賣點，再提供標題、分層賣點、使用情境、證明資訊與行動引導。
ecommerce:product-copy.materialHint: 商品資訊、目標族群、規格參數、真實賣點和證明資料（可選）
ecommerce:product-copy.followUpPrompt: 請檢視剛才的商品文案，區分可驗證事實與行銷表達，並分別改善詳情頁首屏、賣點區和行動引導。
ecommerce:product-copy.output: 商品標題、分層賣點、情境說明、證明資訊和行動引導

ecommerce:campaign-plan.title: 活動企劃
ecommerce:campaign-plan.description: 規劃目標、節奏、通路與執行方式
ecommerce:campaign-plan.prompt: 請為[商品或商店]規劃行銷活動，包含活動目標、目標族群、節奏、各通路動作、預算、庫存風險與檢討指標。
ecommerce:campaign-plan.materialHint: 活動目標、商品、預算、週期、通路、庫存和歷史資料（可選）
ecommerce:campaign-plan.followUpPrompt: 請將剛才的活動方案細化為執行表，補充每日節點、負責人、預算分配、庫存預警和檢討指標。
ecommerce:campaign-plan.output: 活動主題、目標受眾、時間節奏、通路動作、預算和檢討指標

ecommerce:competitor-analysis.title: 競品分析
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.description: 比較定位、價格、內容與顧客評價
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.prompt: 請分析[競品]的定位、價格、訴求、頁面內容與顧客評價，並找出可行的差異化機會。
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.materialHint: 自家商品、競品資料、價格、頁面內容和使用者評價（可選）
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.followUpPrompt: 請根據剛才的競品分析，補充證據來源與差異化優先順序，並提出 3 個可立即驗證的小型實驗。
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.output: 定位、價格、賣點、頁面和評價差異的競品分析報告

ecommerce:review-customer-service.title: 評價與客服
ecommerce:review-customer-service.description: 分析評價並準備客服回覆
ecommerce:review-customer-service.prompt: 請分析[商品或商店]的顧客評價，找出反覆出現的問題與改善方向，再擬定售前、異議處理、物流及售後客服回覆。
ecommerce:review-customer-service.materialHint: 商品或店鋪資訊、使用者評價、常見問題、物流和售後規則（可選）
ecommerce:review-customer-service.followUpPrompt: 請將剛才的評價分析轉成處理清單，並依售前、異議、物流與售後情境改善回覆話術和升級條件。
ecommerce:review-customer-service.output: 評價問題分類、改善建議和涵蓋售前售後的客服話術

office:document-writing.title: 文件撰寫
office:document-writing.description: 依來源資料撰寫正式文件
office:document-writing.prompt: 請將[參考資料]整理成[文件類型]。先確認讀者與用途，再提供清楚的結構和初稿。
office:document-writing.materialHint: 參考資料、文件類型、讀者、用途、篇幅和格式要求（可選）
office:document-writing.followUpPrompt: 請校閱剛才的文件初稿，檢查結構、事實、術語和語氣，列出仍需我確認的資訊後再提供修訂版。
office:document-writing.output: 清楚的文件結構、正文初稿和待確認問題

office:spreadsheet-analysis.title: 試算表分析
office:spreadsheet-analysis.description: 清理、分析並摘要業務資料
office:spreadsheet-analysis.prompt: 請處理[試算表]。先說明可讀取的內容，再清理資料、分析關鍵指標並摘要主要發現。
office:spreadsheet-analysis.materialHint: 試算表檔案、欄位說明、業務問題、時間範圍和指標定義（可選）
office:spreadsheet-analysis.followUpPrompt: 請繼續核對剛才的試算表分析，說明資料口徑、異常值處理與結論限制，並補充最值得呈現的圖表方案。
office:spreadsheet-analysis.output: 清理說明、關鍵指標、異常項目、分析結論和圖表建議

office:meeting-minutes.title: 會議紀錄
office:meeting-minutes.description: 整理決議、負責人與截止時間
office:meeting-minutes.prompt: 請將[會議筆記]整理成會議紀錄，列出決議、待辦事項、負責人、截止時間與未決問題。
office:meeting-minutes.materialHint: 會議逐字稿、手寫紀錄、與會者和會議議程（可選）
office:meeting-minutes.followUpPrompt: 請檢視剛才的會議紀錄，區分已決事項、待辦與未決問題，並補充每項的負責人、截止時間和相依關係。
office:meeting-minutes.output: 會議結論、待辦事項、負責人、截止時間和未決問題

office:presentation-outline.title: 簡報大綱
office:presentation-outline.description: 規劃大綱、重點與投影片流程
office:presentation-outline.prompt: 請為[主題]建立簡報大綱。先確認聽眾、目標與時長，再逐頁列出重點和所需資料。
office:presentation-outline.materialHint: 簡報主題、聽眾、時長、已有資料和品牌範本（可選）
office:presentation-outline.followUpPrompt: 請將剛才的簡報大綱細化為逐頁講稿，補充每頁的核心結論、所需證據、講述時間和視覺表達。
office:presentation-outline.output: 逐頁目的、核心要點、證據需求和視覺建議

research:source-organization.title: 資料整理
research:source-organization.description: 整理來源、主題、證據與待查問題
research:source-organization.prompt: 請將我提供的[資料]依主題、來源、關鍵發現、證據與可靠性整理，並列出待查問題。
research:source-organization.materialHint: 資料檔案或連結、整理目的、研究範圍和來源標準（可選）
research:source-organization.followUpPrompt: 請繼續整理剛才的資料，移除重複來源，標出相互印證或衝突的證據，並產生優先查證的問題清單。
research:source-organization.output: 資料目錄、主題摘要、證據出處、可靠性說明和待查問題

research:viewpoint-comparison.title: 觀點比較
research:viewpoint-comparison.description: 評估證據、分歧與適用條件
research:viewpoint-comparison.prompt: 請比較對[問題]的不同觀點，說明證據、分歧、適用條件，並提出平衡的結論。
research:viewpoint-comparison.materialHint: 待比較的問題、主要觀點、已有來源和判斷標準（可選）
research:viewpoint-comparison.followUpPrompt: 請檢視剛才的觀點比較，評估證據強弱與適用範圍，並說明哪些新證據會改變目前判斷。
research:viewpoint-comparison.output: 證據對照、共識與分歧、適用條件和綜合判斷

research:learning-plan.title: 學習計畫
research:learning-plan.description: 設定里程碑、學習素材與練習
research:learning-plan.prompt: 請依照我的目前程度、可用時間與目標，為[主題]建立學習計畫，包含階段、資源與練習。
research:learning-plan.materialHint: 學習目標、目前程度、可用時間、截止日期和已有資料（可選）
research:learning-plan.followUpPrompt: 請將剛才的學習計畫細化到第一週，安排每日任務、練習與檢查標準，並提供進度落後時的調整方案。
research:learning-plan.output: 分階段目標、每週任務、學習資料、練習和檢查點

research:research-report.title: 研究報告
research:research-report.description: 以問題、方法、發現與結論完成報告
research:research-report.prompt: 請撰寫關於[研究問題]的研究報告，包含背景、方法、來源、發現、限制、結論與建議。
research:research-report.materialHint: 研究問題、資料來源、分析範圍、讀者和格式要求（可選）
research:research-report.followUpPrompt: 請校閱剛才的研究報告，區分結論、證據與推論，補充研究限制，並依重要性列出仍需驗證的內容。
research:research-report.output: 研究背景、方法、證據、發現、限制、結論和建議

family:travel-plan.title: 旅遊規劃
family:travel-plan.description: 規劃路線、時程、費用與備案
family:travel-plan.prompt: 請規劃前往[目的地]的家庭旅行。先確認同行成員、日期與預算，再提供路線、時程、費用、預訂事項與備案。
family:travel-plan.materialHint: 目的地、家庭成員、日期、預算、旅遊偏好和限制（可選）
family:travel-plan.followUpPrompt: 請將剛才的旅行規劃細化為每日行程，補充交通銜接、預訂節點、費用區間、兒童或長者需求和天候備案。
family:travel-plan.output: 旅行路線、時間安排、費用、預訂事項和備選方案

family:family-checklist.title: 家庭清單
family:family-checklist.description: 整理項目、負責人、時間與完成狀態
family:family-checklist.prompt: 請將[家庭事項]整理成分類清單，列出物品或任務、負責人、時間與完成檢查。
family:family-checklist.materialHint: 家庭事項、成員、截止時間、現有物品和特殊需求（可選）
family:family-checklist.followUpPrompt: 請檢視剛才的家庭清單，合併重複項目，補充負責人、截止時間、前置條件和出發前的最後檢查。
family:family-checklist.output: 依類別整理的家庭清單、負責人、時間節點和檢查狀態

family:purchase-comparison.title: 選購比較
family:purchase-comparison.description: 比較價格、品質、風險與使用情境
family:purchase-comparison.prompt: 請從價格、品質、功能、評價、售後服務與適用性比較[商品 A]和[商品 B]，並提出購買建議。
family:purchase-comparison.materialHint: 候選商品、預算、使用需求、規格、評價和售後條件（可選）
family:purchase-comparison.followUpPrompt: 請根據剛才的選購比較，依預算、核心需求與風險重新排序，並列出購買前必須確認的規格和售後條款。
family:purchase-comparison.output: 購買選項比較、關鍵取捨、風險提示和推薦結論

family:schedule-plan.title: 日程安排
family:schedule-plan.description: 安排負責人、提醒與檢查清單
family:schedule-plan.prompt: 請將[家庭事項]整理成日程安排，列出時間、家庭成員分工、所需物品與提醒。
family:schedule-plan.materialHint: 家庭成員、固定事項、可用時段、優先順序和個人偏好（可選）
family:schedule-plan.followUpPrompt: 請檢查剛才的日程安排是否衝突，補充緩衝時間、成員分工、提醒節點，以及臨時變更時的替代方案。
family:schedule-plan.output: 依日期和成員整理的安排、衝突提示、緩衝時間和提醒

compass:goal-breakdown.title: Goal breakdown
compass:goal-breakdown.description: Break down goals, steps, timing, and deliverables
compass:goal-breakdown.prompt: Break down [goal] into executable steps with milestones, priorities, deadlines, and the next action.
compass:goal-breakdown.materialHint: Goal, deadline, current progress, and constraints (optional)
compass:goal-breakdown.followUpPrompt: Review the goal breakdown above for missing dependencies, then make the next action specific with an owner, start time, and definition of done.
compass:goal-breakdown.output: Goal breakdown, milestones, priorities, and next actions

compass:execution-plan.title: Execution plan
compass:execution-plan.description: Schedule stages, timing, owners, and checkpoints
compass:execution-plan.prompt: Create an execution plan for [goal] with phased tasks, timing, owners, checkpoints, risks, and adjustment conditions.
compass:execution-plan.materialHint: Goal, deadline, available resources, participants, and constraints (optional)
compass:execution-plan.followUpPrompt: Review the execution plan above and add the critical path, resource conflicts, risk triggers, and acceptance criteria for each checkpoint.
compass:execution-plan.output: Phased execution plan with timeline, owners, checkpoints, and risk responses

compass:option-comparison.title: Compare options
compass:option-comparison.description: Weigh cost, risk, and expected results
compass:option-comparison.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] by cost, outcome, risk, and fit, then make a clear recommendation.
compass:option-comparison.materialHint: Options, budget, time constraints, and decision criteria (optional)
compass:option-comparison.followUpPrompt: Extend the comparison above with weighted criteria and sensitivity analysis, and explain which changes would justify choosing the other option.
compass:option-comparison.output: Option comparison, trade-offs, fit conditions, and an evidence-based recommendation

compass:comprehensive-analysis.title: Comprehensive analysis
compass:comprehensive-analysis.description: Combine goals, context, evidence, risks, and recommendations
compass:comprehensive-analysis.prompt: Analyze [question] comprehensively. Confirm the goal and context, then assess evidence, key factors, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
compass:comprehensive-analysis.materialHint: Question, background, objective, data, and constraints (optional)
compass:comprehensive-analysis.followUpPrompt: Refine the analysis above by separating facts, assumptions, and open questions, then rank the recommendations by impact and urgency.
compass:comprehensive-analysis.output: Current-state assessment, evidence, key factors, risks, opportunities, and actions

content:topic-planning.title: Topic planning
content:topic-planning.description: Define audience, angle, and a content series
content:topic-planning.prompt: Plan topics about [subject]. Confirm the platform, audience, and goal, then give me 10 specific ideas with reasons.
content:topic-planning.materialHint: Theme, platform, audience, account positioning, and reference content (optional)
content:topic-planning.followUpPrompt: Select the three strongest ideas from the topic plan above and add title directions, an outline, material needs, and a recommended publishing order for each.
content:topic-planning.output: Grouped topic ideas with angles and reasons to prioritize them

content:long-form-writing.title: Long-form writing
content:long-form-writing.description: Write a complete, editable long-form piece
content:long-form-writing.prompt: Write a long-form [platform] piece about [subject]. Confirm audience, tone, and length, then deliver a title, opening, structured body, and closing action.
content:long-form-writing.materialHint: Theme, audience, platform, tone, length, and factual material (optional)
content:long-form-writing.followUpPrompt: Edit the long-form draft above for factual support and logical gaps, then improve the title, opening, transitions, and closing call to action.
content:long-form-writing.output: Long-form draft with a title, opening, section structure, and closing action

content:short-video-script.title: Short-video script
content:short-video-script.description: Design the hook, spoken lines, visuals, and pace
content:short-video-script.prompt: Write a [platform and duration] short-video script about [topic], including the hook, spoken lines, visual cues, pacing, and call to action.
content:short-video-script.materialHint: Topic, platform, audience, video length, product information, and references (optional)
content:short-video-script.followUpPrompt: Turn the short-video script above into a second-by-second plan covering spoken lines, visuals, captions, transitions, and required materials.
content:short-video-script.output: Short-video script with a hook, spoken lines, visual cues, pacing, and call to action

content:rewrite-polish.title: Rewrite and polish
content:rewrite-polish.description: Preserve meaning while refining structure, voice, and expression
content:rewrite-polish.prompt: Improve and polish the copy I provide while preserving its facts and intent. Refine the title, opening, structure, voice, and pace.
content:rewrite-polish.materialHint: Original copy, platform, audience, target tone, and facts to preserve (optional)
content:rewrite-polish.followUpPrompt: Compare the polished copy above with the original, explain the key changes, then provide one more concise version and one more engaging version.
content:rewrite-polish.output: Polished copy that preserves meaning, with change notes and title options

video:shooting-script.title: Shooting script
video:shooting-script.description: Plan spoken lines, visuals, and pace
video:shooting-script.prompt: Write a [platform and duration] shooting script about [topic], including hook, spoken lines, visual cues, and call to action.
video:shooting-script.materialHint: Topic, platform, duration, people, product details, and shooting conditions (optional)
video:shooting-script.followUpPrompt: Convert the shooting script above into a production checklist with locations, performer actions, props, camera positions, audio needs, and estimated timing.
video:shooting-script.output: Structured spoken lines, visuals, actions, props, and timing guidance

video:storyboard.title: Storyboard
video:storyboard.description: Define shot size, camera, action, and timing
video:storyboard.prompt: Turn my script into a storyboard with shot number, framing, visual, dialogue, camera, duration, and transition.
video:storyboard.materialHint: Script, reference videos, target duration, aspect ratio, and available locations (optional)
video:storyboard.followUpPrompt: Review the storyboard above and add shot continuity, backup shots, on-set risks, and a shooting priority for each shot.
video:storyboard.output: Storyboard with shot number, framing, camera, visuals, lines, timing, and transitions

video:editing-rhythm.title: Editing rhythm
video:editing-rhythm.description: Plan editing structure, timing, and emotional progression
video:editing-rhythm.prompt: Design the editing rhythm for [video topic], mapping structure, footage choices, emotional changes, transitions, and pacing by time segment.
video:editing-rhythm.materialHint: Script or footage, platform, target duration, audience, and pacing references (optional)
video:editing-rhythm.followUpPrompt: Map the editing plan above onto a timeline, marking footage to keep or cut, music beats, caption density, and transition points.
video:editing-rhythm.output: Section timing, editing rhythm, footage choices, emotional curve, and transition guidance

video:title-cover.title: Title and cover
video:title-cover.description: Generate title directions, cover copy, and visual guidance
video:title-cover.prompt: Create title and cover options for [video topic], including multiple titles, cover copy, composition, visual priorities, and testing ideas.
video:title-cover.materialHint: Video topic, platform, audience, core message, and cover assets (optional)
video:title-cover.followUpPrompt: Choose the three strongest title-and-cover combinations above and explain the audience, information hierarchy, visual focus, and A/B test for each.
video:title-cover.output: Title options, cover copy, composition, visual priorities, and test ideas

ecommerce:product-copy.title: Product copy
ecommerce:product-copy.description: Write headlines, benefits, scenarios, and conversion copy
ecommerce:product-copy.prompt: Write product copy for [product]. Confirm the audience, price range, and proven benefits, then provide a headline, layered benefits, use cases, proof points, and call to action.
ecommerce:product-copy.materialHint: Product details, audience, specifications, proven benefits, and supporting evidence (optional)
ecommerce:product-copy.followUpPrompt: Review the product copy above, separate verifiable facts from marketing language, and optimize the opening section, benefit section, and call to action.
ecommerce:product-copy.output: Product headline, layered benefits, use cases, proof points, and call to action

ecommerce:campaign-plan.title: Campaign plan
ecommerce:campaign-plan.description: Plan objectives, cadence, channels, and execution
ecommerce:campaign-plan.prompt: Create a campaign plan for [product or store], covering the objective, audience, cadence, channel actions, budget, inventory risks, and review metrics.
ecommerce:campaign-plan.materialHint: Campaign objective, products, budget, period, channels, inventory, and historical data (optional)
ecommerce:campaign-plan.followUpPrompt: Turn the campaign plan above into an execution schedule with daily milestones, owners, budget allocation, inventory alerts, and review metrics.
ecommerce:campaign-plan.output: Campaign theme, audience, timeline, channel actions, budget, and review metrics

ecommerce:competitor-analysis.title: Competitor analysis
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.description: Compare positioning, price, content, and customer feedback
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.prompt: Analyze [competitor] across positioning, price, claims, page content, and reviews, then identify differentiation opportunities.
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.materialHint: Your product, competitor materials, prices, page content, and customer reviews (optional)
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.followUpPrompt: Extend the competitor analysis above with evidence sources and differentiation priorities, then propose three small experiments that can be tested immediately.
ecommerce:competitor-analysis.output: Competitor report covering positioning, price, claims, page content, and review differences

ecommerce:review-customer-service.title: Reviews and customer service
ecommerce:review-customer-service.description: Analyze reviews and prepare customer-service responses
ecommerce:review-customer-service.prompt: Analyze customer reviews for [product or store], identify recurring issues and improvements, then create customer-service responses for presales, objections, shipping, and after-sales.
ecommerce:review-customer-service.materialHint: Product or store details, customer reviews, FAQs, shipping, and after-sales policies (optional)
ecommerce:review-customer-service.followUpPrompt: Turn the review analysis above into an action list, then refine the responses and escalation rules for presales, objections, shipping, and after-sales.
ecommerce:review-customer-service.output: Review themes, improvement actions, and customer-service scripts for presales and support

office:document-writing.title: Document writing
office:document-writing.description: Build a formal document from source material
office:document-writing.prompt: Turn my source material into a [document type]. Confirm the audience and purpose, then produce a clear structure and draft.
office:document-writing.materialHint: Source material, document type, audience, purpose, length, and format (optional)
office:document-writing.followUpPrompt: Edit the document draft above for structure, facts, terminology, and tone, list the information that still needs my confirmation, and then provide a revised version.
office:document-writing.output: Clear document structure, working draft, and open questions

office:spreadsheet-analysis.title: Spreadsheet analysis
office:spreadsheet-analysis.description: Clean, analyze, and summarize business data
office:spreadsheet-analysis.prompt: Process the spreadsheet I provide. Explain what can be read, then clean it, analyze key metrics, and summarize findings.
office:spreadsheet-analysis.materialHint: Spreadsheet, field definitions, business questions, date range, and metric rules (optional)
office:spreadsheet-analysis.followUpPrompt: Validate the spreadsheet analysis above, explain metric definitions, anomaly handling, and conclusion limits, then recommend the most useful charts.
office:spreadsheet-analysis.output: Cleaning notes, key metrics, anomalies, findings, and chart suggestions

office:meeting-minutes.title: Meeting minutes
office:meeting-minutes.prompt: Turn these meeting notes into minutes with decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and open questions.
office:meeting-minutes.materialHint: Transcript, notes, attendee list, and meeting agenda (optional)
office:meeting-minutes.followUpPrompt: Review the meeting minutes above, separate decisions, action items, and open questions, and add an owner, deadline, and dependency for each item.
office:meeting-minutes.output: Decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and unresolved questions

office:presentation-outline.title: Presentation outline
office:presentation-outline.description: Develop an outline, key points, and slide flow
office:presentation-outline.prompt: Create a presentation outline for [topic]. Confirm the audience, goal, and duration, then give slide-by-slide points and data needs.
office:presentation-outline.materialHint: Presentation topic, audience, duration, available data, and brand template (optional)
office:presentation-outline.followUpPrompt: Expand the presentation outline above into a slide-by-slide script with each slide’s main conclusion, evidence needs, speaking time, and visual treatment.
office:presentation-outline.output: Slide-by-slide purpose, key points, evidence needs, and visual direction

research:source-organization.title: Source organization
research:source-organization.description: Organize sources, themes, evidence, and open questions
research:source-organization.prompt: Organize the [source material] I provide by theme, source, key finding, evidence, and reliability, then list open questions.
research:source-organization.materialHint: Files or links, organization goal, research scope, and source standards (optional)
research:source-organization.followUpPrompt: Refine the source organization above by removing duplicates, marking corroborating or conflicting evidence, and producing a prioritized verification list.
research:source-organization.output: Source catalog with thematic summaries, evidence references, reliability notes, and open questions

research:viewpoint-comparison.title: Viewpoint comparison
research:viewpoint-comparison.prompt: Compare different viewpoints on [question], including evidence, disagreements, applicable conditions, and a balanced conclusion.
research:viewpoint-comparison.materialHint: Question, main viewpoints, available sources, and decision criteria (optional)
research:viewpoint-comparison.followUpPrompt: Review the viewpoint comparison above for evidence strength and limits of applicability, and explain what new evidence would change the current judgment.
research:viewpoint-comparison.output: Evidence matrix, agreements, disagreements, conditions, and a balanced judgment

research:learning-plan.title: Learning plan
research:learning-plan.prompt: Create a learning plan for [topic] based on my current level, available time, and goal, with stages, resources, and exercises.
research:learning-plan.materialHint: Learning goal, current level, available time, deadline, and existing resources (optional)
research:learning-plan.followUpPrompt: Turn the learning plan above into a detailed first week with daily tasks, exercises, success checks, and an adjustment plan if progress falls behind.
research:learning-plan.output: Learning stages, weekly tasks, materials, practice, and checkpoints

research:research-report.title: Research report
research:research-report.description: Develop a complete report with question, method, findings, and conclusion
research:research-report.prompt: Write a research report about [research question], covering background, method, sources, findings, limitations, conclusions, and recommendations.
research:research-report.materialHint: Research question, sources, analysis scope, audience, and format requirements (optional)
research:research-report.followUpPrompt: Edit the research report above by separating conclusions, evidence, and inference, strengthening the limitations section, and prioritizing what still needs verification.
research:research-report.output: Research background, method, evidence, findings, limitations, conclusion, and recommendations

family:travel-plan.title: Travel plan
family:travel-plan.description: Plan routes, timing, cost, and alternatives
family:travel-plan.prompt: Create a travel plan for a family trip to [destination]. Confirm travelers, dates, and budget, then provide routes, timing, costs, bookings, and alternatives.
family:travel-plan.materialHint: Destination, family members, dates, budget, travel preferences, and constraints (optional)
family:travel-plan.followUpPrompt: Expand the travel plan above into a daily itinerary with transport connections, booking deadlines, cost ranges, child or older-traveler needs, and weather alternatives.
family:travel-plan.output: Travel route, schedule, costs, bookings, and alternative plans

family:family-checklist.title: Family checklist
family:family-checklist.description: Organize items, owners, timing, and completion status
family:family-checklist.prompt: Turn [household task] into a family checklist grouped by category, with items or tasks, owners, timing, and completion checks.
family:family-checklist.materialHint: Household task, family members, deadline, available items, and special needs (optional)
family:family-checklist.followUpPrompt: Review the family checklist above, merge duplicates, and add an owner, deadline, prerequisite, and final pre-departure check where relevant.
family:family-checklist.output: Family checklist grouped by category with owners, timing, and completion checks

family:purchase-comparison.title: Purchase comparison
family:purchase-comparison.description: Compare price, quality, risks, and use cases
family:purchase-comparison.prompt: Compare the purchase options [product A] and [product B] by price, quality, features, reviews, support, and fit, then recommend one.
family:purchase-comparison.materialHint: Candidate products, budget, use needs, specifications, reviews, and warranty terms (optional)
family:purchase-comparison.followUpPrompt: Re-rank the purchase options above by budget, essential needs, and risk, then list the specifications and support terms that must be verified before buying.
family:purchase-comparison.output: Purchase comparison with key trade-offs, risks, and a recommendation

family:schedule-plan.title: Schedule plan
family:schedule-plan.prompt: Turn [household task] into a schedule plan with timing, owner assignments, required items, and reminders.
family:schedule-plan.materialHint: Family members, fixed events, available times, priorities, and preferences (optional)
family:schedule-plan.followUpPrompt: Check the schedule above for conflicts and add buffer time, family assignments, reminder points, and alternatives for last-minute changes.
family:schedule-plan.output: Schedule by date and person, with conflicts, buffer time, and reminders
